concept.reason: Actual author schematic and measured specimen photos provide bounded reconstruction without extra concept renders.

scope: Whole tall penguin with long spear-shaped bill and broad flattened flippers, original reconstruction with explicitly inferred head.

scientific_limits.en: MLP12-I-20-289 is a partial postcranial skeleton lacking skull and complete wings. Its femur and coracoid are measured; whole length is allometric estimate, not standing height or articulated measurement. Fig1 is an author schematic not to scale, not a fossil head. No reliably associated Palaeeudyptes skull establishes this bill: long spear bill derives from tentative Palaeeudyptes/Anthropornis cranial assignments and comparative stem penguins. Exact head, flipper outline, colors and soft tissues are original estimates. Do not borrow Icadyptes skull as genus-specific evidence or claim a2m individual.
scientific_limits.zh: MLP12-I-20-289为部分颅后骨架，无颅及完整翼。股骨/乌喙骨为实测，全长为异速推估非站高或关联全体实测。Fig1是作者不按比例示意，头不是化石。无可靠关联本属颅能实证此喙，长矛喙来自暂归本属/Anthropornis的头部及干群企鹅比较；具体头/鳍轮廓、色彩、软组织为原创估计，不拿Icadyptes颅当本属证据，不夸称2米个体。

taxon: Palaeeudyptes, body anchored to P. klekowskii
classification: Aves, Sphenisciformes; extinct stem penguin, not a modern crown species

scale.model_status: Dimensions labeled model are artistic estimates. Published length range is full body length, not vertical standing height.

diagnostic_targets: Tall upright elongated penguin body, moderately long neck tapering to small head, not a squat modern penguin toy.
Long narrow straight spear-shaped bill, explicitly comparative inference; not hooked parrot bill or broad duck bill.
Broad dorsoventrally flattened paddle flippers with clear shoulder transition and tapering tip, not feathered flying wings or cylinders.
Moderately deep body with short legs set low and rearward, broad supporting webbed feet, short wedge tail.
Restrained neutral inferred plumage, no claimed fossil pigment or modern emperor yellow ear patches.
Keep full bird coherent: bill, neck, body, both flippers and feet; no skeleton/slab downgrade.
acceptance: Original long spear bill, tall penguin body and broad flippers all preserved.
Front/top show genuinely flattened broad flippers; side shows elongated body/neck and short supported legs.
Metadata states bill inference and no known associated skull, measurements and total-length estimates distinct.
Do not use size alone to distinguish: longer neck/body and broad pointed paddles are essential.
Four exactGLB views, two isolated rebuilds and independent review.
